name: Wakusei Koukitai Little Cats
original_name: 惑星攻機隊りとるキャッツ
source:
The galaxy is threatened by robotic enemies from a remote space. In order to stop them, giant combat robots were deployed to a space station under the command of Colonel Goofy Reagan. The combat robots are navigated by the best pilots, which happen to be cute teenage girls. Since the Colonel is very busy, he needs somebody to watch over the girls and train them. This somebody would be Major David Lowe, the protagonist of the game...

Little Cats is somewhat similar to Sakura Taisen games, with adventure and dating elements reduced, and simulation elements added. David has to make schedules for the girls and decide how much and what exactly they should train. Running competitions, shooting range, robot navigation - everything can be trained, but at the expense of the girls' stamina, which means they will need to rest as well. During the simulation mode, it is also possible to wander around the space station and spend time with the girls.

The strategy part consists of navigating the robots over a battle field in tun-based fashion. The robots have a wide range of attacks, and it is possible to change their weapons and use items in combat. Once the robots attack each other, an automatic attack sequence is shown. 

[from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9u-49-en-70-l9v.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
來自遙遠宇宙的機器人敵軍威脅著整個銀河。為阻止它們，人類把巨型戰鬥機器人部署到太空站，交由古菲．雷根上校指揮。駕駛這些機器人的都是最優秀的飛行員，而她們恰好是一群可愛的少女。上校公務繁忙，需要有人照看並訓練她們。這個人便是遊戲主角大衛．洛少校……

《惑星攻機隊Little Cats》與《櫻花大戰》系列有些相似，但弱化了冒險與戀愛部分，增加了模擬經營要素。大衛需要為少女們安排作息，並決定她們該訓練什麼、訓練多久。跑步、射擊和機器人駕駛等項目都能訓練，但都會消耗少女們的體力，因此也必須安排休息。在模擬模式中，玩家還可以在太空站內四處走動，與少女們相處。

策略部分採用回合制，玩家要操縱機器人在戰場上移動。機器人擁有豐富的攻擊手段，還能更換武器，並在戰鬥中使用道具。雙方機器人交戰時，遊戲會自動播放攻擊演出。
